climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: A Côte de Beaune appellation for red wine from Pinot Noir, covering only seven premier cru climats in Meursault and Puligny-Montrachet.
